section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes data collection for a study conducted via Prolific Academic, an online crowdsourcing marketplace, between November 8-11, 2016. Participation was limited to U.K. citizens of adult age, and participants completed an anonymous survey on 'health, well-being, and personality' for £1.00 compensation. The section indicates that measures and demographic details were presented in counterbalanced order, though specific sample characteristics, assessment instruments, and results are not detailed in this section.
